# Serum Vials

> > Serum Vials is a wholesale pharmaceutical packaging supplier specializing in vials, seals, stoppers, and crimping equipment for compounding pharmacies and laboratories.

Based in Lawrence, Kansas, Serum Vials (operated by Voigt Global Distribution Inc.) provides USP 797-compliant pharmaceutical packaging supplies including clear and amber glass vials, West flip-off seals, aluminum vial seals, and KEBBY crimpers. The site serves compounding pharmacies, laboratories, and wholesale buyers with bulk discounts and international shipping.
